findings.titulo: Escape the pipe in the table cell.
findings.trecho: **🎯 Functional Correctness** | **🟡 Minor** | **⚡ Quick win**  **Escape the pipe in the table cell.**  Line 439 includes a literal `|` in the inline `grep` command. GFM requires pipes inside table cells, including inline code, to be escaped. Otherwise, this row adds a cell, shifts later values, and can drop the trailing column. ([github.github.com](https://github.github.com/gfm/?source=post_page---
